gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-bespoke-sans: Scrappy and pen-drawn, Nanum Pen Script crowds its letters with gaping e mouths, while Bespoke Sans keeps its curves open and sharp. Long paragraphs would wear thin in that hand; it wants a few words.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-neco: Hand-drawn letters with gaping e mouths and tight spacing set the tone in Nanum Pen Script. But Neco, a dignified serif, swells gently from hairline to stem and rewards a few lines.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-plein: Loose and friendly, Nanum Pen Script has sturdy joins; Plein opens a clear channel into each round letter. Long paragraphs clearly belong to Plein, not to the handwriting up top.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-recia: Nanum Pen Script draws gaping e mouths in a constant-width line, like a marker, with tight spacing. But Recia's faint modulation makes a sharp partner for that marker line, though long paragraphs would strain the handwriting.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-rowan: Neon-tube lettering of constant thickness, with gaping e mouths, is what Nanum Pen Script brings. Rowan, literary and friendly, forms a texture where light strokes barely recede, so brief spells of reading stay warm.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-spline-sans: Nanum Pen Script writes with gaping e mouths, while Spline Sans leaves wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Warmth runs through both, handwritten above, contemporary below, good for a few lines.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-plus-jakarta-san: Plus Jakarta Sans draws modern, precise monoline sans-serif letters with curve endings kept apart, beneath the hand-drawn Nanum Pen Script. The heading font charms in brief bursts; the body font handles steadier reading.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-space-grotesk: Nanum Pen Script is gaping-mouthed and hand-drawn, with tightly packed letters. It does its best work in a line or two, while Space Grotesk, geometric and constant in width, carries the rest.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-bespoke-sans: Tight-knit and pen-traced, Neucha leaves its broad-nib curves unfinished, in tubelike lines of constant weight. And Bespoke Sans, a sharp, refined sans, gives it open curves to lean on across a few lines.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-plein: Graceful from the first line, Neucha traces curves with a broad nib. Plein's clean channel into each round letter gives that hand-drawn grace a steady partner, for brief spells of reading.
